remarks: Welcome to this inviting 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom Cape Cod-style home nestled in Stamford's popular Turn of River neighborhood!  From the moment you step inside, you'll feel the warmth and comfort of this thoughtfully laid-out home. The main level offers two spacious bedrooms and a full bathroom, plus a living room, a dining room perfect for gathering, and kitchen. Upstairs, you'll find two more generously sized bedrooms and another full bath, offering just the right balance of space and privacy.  Love outdoor living? You're in for a treat! The fabulous backyard is ideal for relaxing or hosting with a brick paver terrace and built-in fire pit-perfect for summer nights, s'mores, and memory-making.  Need storage? The oversized one-car garage features ample space above, ideal for all your extras. And here's the bonus: a solar panel system that helps you save on energy bills by generating free electricity during the sunny summer months!  Located close to shops, parks, and commuter routes, this home offers comfort, convenience, and an easygoing lifestyle in a location that just feels right.  Come see why this Turn of River gem is the perfect place to start your next chapter!
